sources.title: MOSS-Image | Text-to-Image Generation with Native Layout Control
sources.snippet: MOSS-Image is a text-to-image model family from OpenMOSS, comprising a base model and a curated-data fine-tuned model. In addition to natural-language prompts, MOSS-Image supports native text-driven layout generation: objects, rendered text, and their spatial positions can be specified in a JSON prompt.
